Two bugs:

1. IP addresses wrong: got `c3986500000a0100000a` — wait let me decode. Expected: `...11115470a0000650a00000112b7...` → after TTL/protocol `40 11 15 47` then src `0a 00 00 65` dst `0a 00 00 01`. Mine: `40 11 c3 98 65 00 00 0a 01 00 00 0a` — the IP addresses are byte-swapped! I passed `swip = 0x0a000065u` to `epic_build_roce_ack`, which writes `ip->src_ip = src_ip` directly into a uint32 field that gets serialized little-endian. The existing code used `p->host_ip = htonl(0x0a000001u+...)` in epic_open — i.e., the port structs store IPs in network byte order. My caller passes host-order values. Fix: use htonl() when passing to the builders, or store pre-swapped. I'll use htonl in send_up/send_result.

Also the checksum changes because of that.

2. state[1] "occupied slots" got 4, expected 1. My occ counter increments per accept_data (4 contributions to same slot) — wrong! "occupied slots" = number of slots occupied. I should increment only when a slot is created (first contribution at p). Fix: increment occ only when the slot was not in use before.

Let me fix both.
